summary: Strong test suite across three tiers (unit, integration via act, workflow structure). Covers all stated requirements: dimension expansion, include/exclude rules, strategy settings, size validation, error handling, and GitHub Actions integration. Uses exact JSON matching for determinism. Minor gaps: limited edge cases for unusual inputs (1D matrices, exclude-removes-nothing scenarios, dimension value type variations), and Docker image assumptions in act tests. Excellent organization with clear TDD comments. Would reliably catch regressions on core functionality and specified requirements.
